steps: Draw 3.0 mL bacteriostatic water with a sterile syringe.
Inject slowly down the vial wall to avoid foaming; do not shake vigorously.
Gently roll or swirl the vial until the powder is fully dissolved.
Label the vial with the reconstitution date and store refrigerated at 2–8 °C (35.6–46.4 °F) , protected from light.

protocols.name: Standard / Gradual Titration
protocols.frequency: Frequency: Inject once daily subcutaneously during the initial 8-week tanning phase; transition to 1–2 injections per week for maintenance dosing to sustain pigmentation [3] . This schedule uses the standard 3.0 mL dilution for consistent unit measurements. For ≤10-unit (≤0.10 mL) administrations, consider 30- or 50-unit insulin syringes for improved readability.
